CanvasSession
|
|-- SelectionState                         [single source of truth]
|   `-- items[]                            [ordered, unique IDs]
|       |-- id
|       |-- displayNodeId
|       `-- region?                        [absent = whole diagram]
|           |-- rectangle
|           |-- sourceContentId
|           |-- source revision / captured ASCII
|           `-- selected source-node IDs
|
|-- SelectionCommands                     [one mutation path]
|   |-- replace(items)
|   |-- add(items)
|   |-- toggleDiagram(id)
|   |-- selectRegion(region)
|   |-- remove(itemId)
|   `-- clear()
|       |
|       `-- Shared rules
|           |-- Whole diagram replaces its selected regions
|           |-- Region selection removes its whole-diagram selection
|           |-- Deselecting diagram does not restore old regions
|           |-- Duplicate selections reuse identity
|           `-- Panel visibility does not determine membership
|
|-- Input adapters
|   |-- Plain double-click  ------------> replace([diagram])
|   |-- Ctrl/Meta double-click  --------> toggleDiagram(id)
|   |-- Node click  --------------------> selectRegion(node bounds)
|   |-- Completed Ctrl-drag  -----------> add(diagrams + regions)
|   |-- Explicit deselect  -------------> clear()
|   `-- Panel "select source" action  --> selectRegion(saved context)
|
|-- GesturePreview                        [temporary, separate]
|   |-- Pointer start / current position
|   |-- Marquee bounds / promotion preview
|   `-- Commit once on pointer-up; discard on cancel
|
|-- Consumers                             [read SelectionState]
|   |-- Canvas highlights
|   |-- Selection count / toolbar
|   |-- Copy / move / code / chat actions
|   `-- WebSocket selection serializer
|       |-- diagramIds <- diagram items
|       |-- regions    <- region items
|       |   `-- IDs, source, rectangle, text, stale
|       `-- Transport
|           |-- Initial snapshot
|           |-- Subsequent deltas
|           `-- Server mirror -> connected readers
|
|-- UI interaction state                  [separate from selection]
|   `-- Action-menu / keyboard focus
|
`-- PanelState                            [independent lifetime]
    |-- Code / chat / projection panels
    |-- Captured source context
    |-- Layout / expansion / focus
    `-- Survives selection removal

T2c - Drag, cancel, undo and redo
|-- Peripheral to T2a / T2b / process / fine
|-- Scope: existing-shape translation; no cloning / creation

|-- SelectTool.Translating enters
|   |-- markHistoryStoppingPoint(translating)
|   |-- Capture initial selection and shape state
|   `-- Run translation-start behavior

|-- Pointer movement
|   |-- Derive translated shape positions
|   `-- Update shapes repeatedly -> Store -> pendingDiff

|-- Complete gesture
|   |-- Final shape updates and drop handling
|   |-- Translation-end behavior
|   `-- Keep changes; finish interaction / return to idle

|-- Cancel gesture
|   |-- Translation-cancel callbacks
|   `-- bailToMark(startMark)
|       `-- Restore pre-drag state; do not create redo history

|-- undo()
|   |-- Pause recording; set replay flag
|   |-- Reverse pending + stacked diffs back to a stop
|   |-- applyDiff(..., {ignoreEphemeralKeys: true})
|   `-- Retain replayable changes in redo stack

|-- redo()
|   |-- Pause recording; accumulate forward diff to a stop
|   |-- Apply diff and update stacks
|   `-- Restore recorder mode and replay flag

`-- Replay preserves declared ephemeral update fields
    `-- Diff replay also calls ensureStoreIsUsable()
